notes: 1. Buyer Home Loan URL is https://uat.xrportal.in/homeloan on the BUYER host uat.xrportal.in (NOT uat-web.xrportal.in, which is Admin/Sales-Manager). Direct access requires authentication — an unauthenticated hit redirects to the root login at / .

2. Buyer auth is Mobile-OTP only (no password). UAT mobile = 8888888888, static Buyer OTP = 147258 (this is the BUYER/Channel-Partner OTP; it is NOT the Admin/SM OTP 258369 — see isolation cases). OTP SMS is delivered via Epinet, NOT Kaleyra (FSD-CORRECTION 2026-05-25; Kaleyra is WhatsApp-only). A JWT is issued on verify and stored client-side (BRD §7 'Authentication'; session persists across reload until token expiry).

3. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] = a disposable UAT record/state/credential must be supplied before executing this test (e.g. a buyer with a confirmed allocation, an Easiloan sandbox that returns/withholds offers, a sanction-letter PDF, an admin able to approve/reject the loan, a captured JWT, or simulated low-CIBIL / Easiloan-down conditions). Home loan SUBMIT / APPLY / PROCEED actions WRITE a RegistrationHomeLoan record and trigger bank-partner workflows via Easiloan — see note 5.
4. [VERIFY WITH DEV] = behaviour not confirmed in BRD/FRD/FS/Workflow and not transcribed in visual-memory; confirm before treating Pass/Fail as authoritative.

5. MUTATION-AUTHORISATION WARNING: Any test that clicks Submit > (Step 1), Save Details > / Apply (Step 2), or Proceed > (Pre-Approved upload) MUTATES live UAT data — it creates/updates a RegistrationHomeLoan record, sets homeLoanStep / homeLoanBankSelected / homeLoanOptedOut, and may dispatch a formal application to a partner bank through Easiloan. These tests are marked [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] and MUST NOT be run on a real fixture without explicit user authorisation (CLAUDE.md Pipeline Discipline #7). Capture-only steps (open landing, open a form, inspect fields, trigger the file-picker without confirming) are non-destructive and safe.

6. SILENT-BY-DESIGN: Admin Home Loan approval/rejection dispatches NO buyer SMS/WhatsApp/email — the buyer must refresh the portal to see the new state (BYR_LOAN_FSD_038). Treat the absence of a buyer notification on approval as expected, not a defect (CLAUDE.md Pipeline Discipline #6).

7. STATE MODEL: A home-loan record carries TWO independent columns — process `status` (in_progress -> completed, moved by the buyer) and `loan_approval_status` (moved by admin) — and the UI must read both to render final state (BYR_LOAN_FSD_039). `loan_approval_status` ENUM = pending / approved / admin_rejected / admin_approved (BYR_LOAN_FSD_036); buyer paths only ever set `pending`, the `approved` lowercase value is defined but unreachable from current buyer code (BYR_LOAN_FSD_037, BUG-LOAN-001). Records with `admin_rejected` are excluded from the admin customer-list home-loan indicator (BR §7.3).

8. GLOSSARY: 'New loan' card = 'I want to apply for a new loan' (full Easiloan eligibility path); 'Pre-approved' card = 'I have a pre-approved loan' (upload own bank sanction letter, bypass Easiloan, sets homeLoanOptedOut=true). Step indicator: '1 Loan Eligibility Check' then '2 Loan Offers & Review'. On-screen action buttons: 'Submit >' (Step 1), 'Save Details >' (Step 2), 'Proceed >' (Pre-Approved). 'NOC' = No-Objection Certificate required for bank disbursement, listed in the HomeLoanData component. 'FIRST_DISBURSEMENT' = payment-schedule milestone the bank's loan tranche is credited against. 'HOME_LOAN offer' = automatic discount on the unit Agreement Value, shown in the Cost Sheet, that completing the flow may unlock.

9. EASILOAN is the third-party home-loan aggregator (BRD §2). Step 1 financial details are POSTed to Easiloan, which returns the pre-approved bank offers shown in Step 2 (loan amount, interest rate, monthly EMI, bank). There is NO local interest/EMI calculator in the buyer UI — interest rate and EMI are values RETURNED by Easiloan per offer, so 'EMI estimation' and 'interest rate' coverage is verification of the values Easiloan renders, not of a client-side calculator. LeadSquared (LSQ) and Strapi are out of scope per CLAUDE.md; home-loan documents are stored in LSQ custom-object slots (BYR_LOAN_FSD_040) and blob retrieval is NOT tested.

10. DOC_DRIFT-001 — STEP COUNT & FLOW SHAPE. BRD/FS/Workflow describe a 5-step flow (LoanEligibilityCheck -> LoanOffersReview -> ApplyLoan -> PreapprovedLoan -> Congratulations). The LIVE buyer UI (visual-memory/buyer/home-loan/INDEX.md, recaptured 2026-06-06) presents a 2-card landing ('I want to apply for a new loan' / 'I have a pre-approved loan'), and the new-loan path is a 2-STEP wizard ('1 Loan Eligibility Check' -> '2 Loan Offers & Review') with a combined Personal-Details + Documents form on Step 1; the pre-approved path is a single Upload-Sanction-Letter screen with Proceed. The 5 doc steps are backend/state stages, not 5 distinct screens. LIVE UI WINS — TCs use the observed 2-card / 2-step shape.

11. DOC_DRIFT-002 — ACTION-BUTTON LABELS. BRD/FS 'How to Use' name the buttons 'Check Eligibility' (Step 1), 'Apply'/'Confirm' (Step 2/3), and 'I Have a Pre-Approved Sanction Letter' (CTA). The LIVE UI labels them 'Submit >' (Step 1), 'Save Details >' (Step 2), and 'Proceed >' (pre-approved), with the entry being the card 'I have a pre-approved loan'. LIVE UI WINS — Steps and Expected results quote the on-screen labels; the BRD names are kept only where they help trace the requirement.

12. DOC_DRIFT-003 — PRECONDITION. BRD/Workflow §7.1 state the flow is 'Post-KYC only / after unit allocation'; FS 1.3 hedges 'Flow may be accessible before allocation in some configurations.' The live route loads the eligibility landing for the logged-in test buyer; BYR_LOAN_028 / BYR_LOAN_052 cover both configurations. The exact gating rule is configuration-dependent — [VERIFY WITH DEV] the canonical pre-allocation access rule for UAT.

13. ID SCHEME: this sheet keeps BOTH historical prefixes already in the workbook — BYR_LOAN_NNN / BYR_LOAN_FSD_NNN (baseline) and TC_HOMELOAN_<TYPE>_NNN (supplemental). New TCs continue the highest existing number in the appropriate TC_HOMELOAN type series; existing IDs are NEVER renumbered. Type codes used: UI / FUNC / VAL / NEG / EDGE / BIZ / E2E / REG / API / INT / EXP.

tcs.scenario: [FSD-CORRECTION] loan_approval_status ENUM values are pending/approved/admin_rejected/admin_approved

tcs.scenario: [BUG-REF: BUG-LOAN-001] 'approved' (lowercase) state is unreachable from buyer code
